City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JULY 8, 2015 -
06:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
San Diego Forward: The Regional Plan (SANDAG)
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM #10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the Board if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 6/10/15 Regular Meeting, 6/17/15 Regular Meeting, 6/17/2015 Special Meeting, 6/18/15 Special Meeting and 6/24/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-07-08 Item 8A - Minutes (Updated)
8B.
Summary vacation of an unused portion of road right-of way located at 835-837 Dewitt Avenue. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Maher
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-30 approving the summary vacation of a portion of Dewitt Avenue right-of-way fronting the property at 835-837 Dewitt Avenue.
2015-07-08 Item 8B - Summary Vacation 835-837 Dewitt Ave.
8C.
California Fire Assistance Agreement Policy Update. Contact Person: Fire Chief Daigle
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-41, approving portal-to-portal compensation reimbursement for Fire personnel via the California Fire Assistant Agreement.
2015-07-08 Item 8C - CFAA Policy Update Agenda Report and Resolution
8D.
Donation acceptance from Surfing Madonna Oceans Project. Contact Person: Recreation Superintendent Gorham
1) $10,000 for educational programming at Swami's and Moonlight State Beaches; and 2) $1,000 for the Special Olympics athlete meal support.
2015-07-08 Item 8D - Donation Acceptance from SMOP
8E.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2015-10, titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting an amendment to Title 9; Public Safety, Peace, and Health of the Encinitas Municipal Code by adding a new Section 9.23 to regulate the retail sale of dogs and cats in the City of Encinitas." CASE NUMBER: 15-089 ZOA; APPLICANT: City of Encinitas; LOCATION: Citywide. Contact Person: Associate Planner Winter
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2015-10 titled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting an amendment to Title 9; Public Safety, Peace, and Health of the Encinitas Municipal Code by adding a new Section 9.23 to regulate the retail sale of dogs and cats in the City of Encinitas."
2015-07-08 Item 8E - Ordinance 2010-15 Retail Sale of Dogs and Cats
8F.
Designation of Council Members to represent the City of Encinitas as a voting delegate and a voting delegate-alternate at the League of California Cities (LCC) Annual Conference in September 2015. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2015-40 designating Deputy Mayor Blakespear to represent the City of Encinitas as a voting delegate and Council Member Shaffer as a voting delegate-alternate at the LCC Annual Conference in September 2015.
2015-07-08 Item 8F - LCC Annual Conference Voting Delegate
8G.
Summary vacation on an unused portion of road right-of-way on East F Street and South Vulcan Avenue adjacent to 649 South Vulcan Avenue. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Maher
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-17 approving the summary vacation of a portion of right-of-way located at South Vulcan Avenue and East F Street at 649 South Vulcan Avenue.
2015-07-08 Item 8G - Summary Vacation 649 S Vulcan Ave.
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing of an appeal filed by Dennis LeDuc regarding public improvements required per Planning Commission Resolution 2015-09 approved on April 2, 2015. The appeal was continued from the May 27, 2015 City Council public hearing. CASE NUMBER: 14-151 DR/CDP; APPLICANT / APPELLANT: Dennis and Courtney LeDuc; LOCATION: 1265 Saxony Road (APN 254-180-80). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Maher
Review the new improvement/grading plan submitted by the applicant. Should the proposed grading and improvements satisfy City Council's requirements, Adopt City Council Resolution 2015-29 and set aside public improvements required per Planning Commission Resolution No. 2015-09.
2015-07-08 Item 10A - Appeal of Public Improvements for 1265 Saxony
10B.
Discussion and direction on City of Encinitas Legislative Program for 2015. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Council reviews the 2015 City of Encinitas Legislative Program and provides staff with direction for any modifications.
2015-07-08 Item 10B - Legislative Program
10C.
Summary vacation of an unused portion of road right-of-way located at 1244 Summit Avenue. Continued from City Council meeting on May 13, 2015. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Maher
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-12 approving the summary vacation of a portion of Summit Avenue right-of-way fronting the property at 1244 Summit Avenue.
2015-07-08 Item 10C - Summary Vacation 1244 Summit Ave.
10D.
Subcommittee recommendation for new City Manager Employment Agreement. Contact Person: Mayor Gaspar and Deputy Mayor Blakespear
Review the agreement and take appropriate action.
2015-07-08 Item 10D - Recommendation of CM Contract Brust Subcommittee Report
10E.
Presentation of proposals to buy or lease former Fire Station 2 at 1867 Mackinnon Avenue. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
1) Choose one of the proposals and direct staff to negotiate sale or lease of the property; 2) Direct the City Manager to pursue another alternative not identified in this report; or 3) Take no action.
2015-07-08 Item 10E - Former Fire Station 2
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council initiated item from Council Member Kranz regarding Traffic Circulation Element Update.
2015-07-08 Item 12A - Council Initiated Item - Circulation Element

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
